description: React component for managing and displaying compliance reports in the Mattermost admin console, including report creation, reloading, and listing with status and download links.

classes.name: ComplianceReports
classes.description: React component class for compliance report management in admin console.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches compliance reports on component mount if licensed and enabled.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the list of compliance reports.

methods.name: runReport
methods.description: Creates a new compliance report based on input fields.

methods.name: getDateTime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a date and time string.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the compliance reports UI, including form inputs, report list, and status indicators.
